# Khanom House

> ร้านขนมไทยออนไลน์ — Authentic Thai desserts crafted fresh and delivered to your door.

Khanom House is an e-commerce storefront for traditional Thai sweets such as khanom chan, mango sticky rice, and other handcrafted desserts. Browse the menu, add items to the cart, and check out securely.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured Thai desserts and seasonal highlights.
- [Menu](/products): Full catalog of Thai dessert offerings.
- [Cart](/cart): Review selected items before checkout.
